svg.title: Spiritual-bliss rates decline across tested Claude and OpenAI releases

cc:Work.dc:title: Spiritual-bliss rates decline across tested Claude and OpenAI releases
cc:Work.dc:description: Two benchmark-style line panels show observed spiritual-bliss rates with 95 percent Wilson intervals. Claude declines from 87.8 percent in Opus 4 to zero in Opus 5; OpenAI declines from 20 percent in GPT-4o to zero in the tested GPT-5.6 cell.
